thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: oncall page - GPU pool 'gpu-shared-02' fully utilized, autoscaler not responding for 'chatstream' consumer group. creating INC-10542.
sam.k: ack, grabbing dashboards and HPA state. initial glance: hpa shows no metrics for last 12m. pods pending due to insufficient nodes. queue meters climbing fast.
nora: seeing prometheus-adapter errors: repeated `context deadline exceeded` and high scrape durations. snippet:
```text
E 2026-04-02T03:14:09 prometheus-adapter: scrape timeout (15s) job=inference-metrics
W 2026-04-02T03:14:22 adapter: failed query: upstream timeout
```
lee: metrics-server reports high CPU throttling; also saw one adapter pod OOMKilled ~20m ago. suspect cardinality spike after yesterday's telemetry change.
maya: customer impact: chatflow and notifications teams reporting 502/504 and timeouts for premium tenants. CS alerted and incident linked to customer-facing ticket CUST-7321.
sam.k: live mitigation plan (short): 1) emergency scale chatstream deployment to relieve queue 2) restart prometheus-adapter with increased resources 3) temporarily drop per-tenant label on problematic metric 4) route non-critical traffic to best-effort pool 5) create temporary rate-limit at edge.
nora: manual scale first
```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/chatstream --replicas=12
```
ops-bot: scaled deployment "chatstream" to 12 replicas
sam.k: requesting cloud autoscaler bump +3 GPU nodes for pool gpu-shared-02
infra-bot: autoscaler request submitted; ETA 8-14m depending on availability
lee: applying relabel rule to drop tenant_id for heavy metric `inference_queue_latency`
```yaml
# emergency relabel
- source_labels: ["tenant_id"]
  action: drop
  regex: ".+"
```
nora: prepping adapter restart after scale to avoid losing visibility during manual bump. also increasing adapter memory and lowering concurrency limit.
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring set resources deploy/prometheus-adapter --requests=600Mi --limits=2Gi
kubectl -n monitoring set env deploy/prometheus-adapter ADAPTER_MAX_CONCURRENCY=40
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter
```
ops-bot: rollout restart initiated for deploy/prometheus-adapter
incident-bot: customer-impact note: premium tenants Xylo and MedStream experiencing elevated error rates and latency; severity set to SEV2; account teams notified.
maya: posting status page: degraded - inference latency increased; remediation in progress.
sam.k: adapter logs after restart show warming but still some timeouts. custom metrics endpoint begins returning queue samples:
```json
{"chatstream/queue_len": 912}
```
lee: HPA now sees metrics but desired replicas still low because metric scrape age is high. HPA performing one scale step, but we may need to let it reconcile. manual replicas are absorbing most load for now.
ops-bot: cloud autoscaler responded: 2 new GPU nodes provisioning, 1 node delayed due to quota; expected readiness in ~10m.
ora: note: found a telemetry reg that introduced `tenant_metadata` label into several metrics last night. high-cardinality blowup likely root cause. creating TECH-1410 to revert/patch.
sam.k: monitoring: queue length trend flattening, p95 latency from 7.8s -> 2.6s post-scale. smoke tests show core flows healthy.
oncall-sre: taking handoff for next 4h. watchlist: adapter error rate (>1% 5xx), HPA metric age (>45s stale), queue_len trend, node provisioning progress. escalate if premium customer errors > 1% sustained 5m.
maya: AMs notified, crafting customer email with CTA and ETA.
sam.k: after-action quick hits: add HPA minReplicas for chatstream (fallback), implement cardinality limits in telemetry ingestion, add adapter backpressure circuit-breaker, add runbook item to isolate and drop high-cardinality metrics in emergency.
lee: opening PRs for HPA fallback config and adapter resource recommendations.
nora: will follow up with telemetry team to roll out label-sampling and alert on sudden cardinality spikes. TECH-1410 created.
ops-bot: nodes started becoming Ready at 03:25 UTC for 2/3 requested. pending node still in provisioning due to capacity.
sam.k: handoff notes: i will be available by DMs until 04:00 UTC. do not revert manual scaling until HPA has maintained target and queue < 100 for 20m. dashboard links pinned.
oncall-sre: acknowledged and set alerts/notes. will post status updates every 10m.
maya: status page updated again: partial recovery, most services operational; continued monitoring.
issue: one premium tenant still seeing sporadic 504s — investigating per-tenant routing.
sam.k: marking incident as active mitigations in place. next steps: finalize RCA, schedule postmortem, implement telemetry guards.
oncall-sre: accepted handoff. closing on-call loop but keeping thread open until manual changes are reverted. :white_check_mark:
